definitions.gloss: material; physical; relating to things (rather than people or the mind)
definitions.explanation: Concerning physical things, property or objects, as opposed to people, the mind or abstract matters. Used mostly in law, economics and formal writing.

examples.japanese: {物的|ぶってき}な⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧。
{物的証拠|ぶってきしょうこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。

⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人的|じんてき}→人的：28298_jinteki⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{物的|ぶってき}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The accident caused no injuries, but the damage to property was heavy.

notes:
Usually paired with ⟦{人的|じんてき}→人的：28298_jinteki⟧ (relating to people): {人的被害|じんてきひがい} (casualties) vs {物的被害|ぶってきひがい} (property damage). Mostly attaches directly to a noun without な.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物的証拠|ぶってきしょうこ}: physical evidence
- {物的被害|ぶってきひがい}: property damage
- {物的資源|ぶってきしげん}: material resources

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{物理的|ぶつりてき}→物理的：06197_butsuriteki⟧: physical — about physics or physical space and force (⟦{物理的|ぶつりてき}→物理的：06197_butsuriteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧: physically impossible)
- ⟦{物質的|ぶっしつてき}→物質的：08739_busshitsuteki⟧: material — contrasted with spiritual (⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧)
